note: Spoken text only. Stage directions from the approved script are stripped; the pauses they call for are cut in as silence at the timings below, not spoken and not left to the TTS to invent. Text is verbatim — do not edit to fit timing.

voice.name: Eleanor
voice.source: ElevenLabs shared library (community-uploaded — check the voice's terms before treating it as permanent brand sound)
voice.locked: 2026-08-17 — chosen by ear after auditioning on the real script lines. British English also settles the script's 'favourite', which the American voices had been fighting. Re-direction 2026-08-18: adjusted for conversational 'talking like a mom' delivery at faster pace.
voice.why_these_settings: stability 0.35 lets delivery vary between phrases; high stability produces flat machine cadence. style stays 0 — no performance gloss. speed 0.95 for faster pacing (was 0.85/152wpm → target ~160 wpm). Delivery directions guide conversational, maternal warmth over narrative tone.
voice.measured: Render and measure each take. Targets ~160 wpm for faster, conversational pacing. Renders are NOT deterministic: measure the whole script and re-render if a take lands wide of target.

lines.text: Have you noticed your two-month-old looking right at you?
lines.direction: Real question to another parent, like you're chatting over coffee. Curious, warm, not performed. Gentle lift on 'noticed', natural resolve.

lines.text: Two months is when they start looking back.
lines.direction: Simple fact shared mom-to-mom. Warm certainty, not lecture. Conversational pace.

lines.text: Faces become the most interesting thing in the room.
lines.direction: Warm, delighted observation. Like you're noticing it in real time with a friend. Natural warmth, not performed.
Sweet, knowing warmth. The smile is in your voice, not performed. Like you're in on a secret together.

lines.text: Smile at them, talk to them — some babies will smile back.
lines.direction: Warm encouragement, like you're inviting her to try something. Slow down here to let it land. Conversational, not instructional.

lines.text: Listen for sounds that aren't crying. A grumble. A small vowel.
lines.direction: Practical tip from someone who knows. Conversational pace, natural rhythm. Let the short phrases breathe.

lines.text: Make the sound back, then wait. Often, they go again.
lines.direction: Warm, encouraging. The smile comes on 'Often, they go again' — the moment of connection. Natural pace, not narration.

lines.text: Some do this at six weeks. Some nearer three months. Both are ordinary.
lines.direction: Reassuring, mom-to-mom. Not performing reassurance, just stating what's true. Warm and normal.
Quiet, intimate, like an aside just to you. Slower, softer, genuine. The heart of it.

lines.text: Save this for the week it happens.
lines.direction: Gentle close. Like you're tucking this moment away together. Warm, settling, conclusive — the final word, not an aside. Let it breathe.
